detailed_results.sql: SELECT id, name, category, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_users FROM users LIMIT 1000
SELECT id, name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT id, user_id, status, total_amount, created_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at > '2026-09-01' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(total_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

SELECT u.id, u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM users AS u JOIN orders AS o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_sold DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, user_id, status, total_amount, created_at FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CAST('2026-10-10' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30 DAYS' AND created_at <= CAST('2026-10-10' AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS september_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01' LIMIT 1000
SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT category, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price, ROUND(CAST(AVG(price) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 3 ORDER BY item_count DESC, order_id ASC LIMIT 1000

WITH user_spending AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) SELECT u.id, u.name, us.total_spent FROM users AS u JOIN user_spending AS us ON u.id = us.user_id WHERE us.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY us.total_spent DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 1000

WITH ranked_products AS (SELECT id, name, category, price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products) SELECT id, name, category, price, price_rank FROM ranked_products WHERE price_rank <= 2 ORDER BY category ASC, price_rank ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1000

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', created_at) ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT u.name, o.id AS order_id, o.total_amount, o.created_at FROM orders AS o JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(total_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_order_val FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY order_count DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 20
